title: Weeknight Malaysian Malai Grill
description: A jammy, springy, weeknight malaysian dish featuring malai and grilling, lacto-vegetarian-friendly
instructions: Prepare the tofu by cutting it into bite-sized pieces and set aside.
In a shallow dish, mix together the malai sauce, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, and red chili for the marinade.
Add the tofu to the marinade and toss to coat. Let it sit for 15 minutes.
Thread the bamboo shoots and bean sprouts onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with a little bit of sesame oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the tofu for 3-4 minutes per side, or until it's golden brown and slightly charred.
Grill the bamboo shoots and bean sprouts for 2-3 minutes per side, or until they're slightly charred.
Remove the tofu and vegetables from the grill and place them on a serving platter.
Sprinkle the chopped cilantro on top of the dish and serve immediately.
Season with salt, black pepper, and a squeeze of lime juice.
Spoon the malai sauce over the top of the dish and sprinkle with a little bit of sugar.
